definition: Disables an organ, but not necessarily by killing individual cells. This includes neurotoxins that block receptor conductance, superantigens, and toxins that degrade lung function, gut function, or are involved in the disruption of blood homeostasis.

Enable resistance of host oxidative killing

Target host cell cycle component or induce alterations in the host cell cycle
